title: Validation and error handling exceed the spec
evidence: src/book_api/core.clj:22-30 type-checks year/isbn and rejects blank title/author; :35-38 maps malformed JSON to 400; :18-20 returns 405 with an Allow header; :88-91 maps uncaught SQLException to 500
suggestion: None — these are correct behaviours beyond the minimum requirements

title: Parameterized SQL and RETURNING * avoid a read-after-write round trip
evidence: src/book_api/db.clj:4-16 hand-rolled PreparedStatement binding; :46-48 and :59-61 use INSERT/UPDATE ... RETURNING *
suggestion: None — SQL injection safe and efficient

title: A fresh JDBC connection is opened per request with no pooling
evidence: src/book_api/db.clj:25-32,34-43,63-66 each call DriverManager/getConnection; create!/update!/get-book/list-books each open their own connection
suggestion: Acceptable for this task; a connection pool (e.g. HikariCP) would matter only under load
